# Security policy

## Supported versions

| Version | Supported |
| --- | --- |
| 2.x | Yes |
| 1.x | Security fixes only |

## Reporting a vulnerability

Use the private reporting form at
[Security advisories](https://github.com/gh-training-ak/contoso-learning/security/advisories/new).
Do not open a public issue.

We acknowledge within two working days.

## Secrets

If you believe a secret reached the default branch, rotate it first, then tell the
platform team. Rewriting history does not revoke a leaked credential.
